name: XHS Lulu Girl Real Automation Test
description: Real test with PyAutoGUI automation - open page, search, and extract data

open_browser.description: Open xiaohongshu.com in browser using PyAutoGUI

args.intent: Take a screenshot and then use PyAutoGUI to open a web browser and navigate to xiaohongshu.com. Look for browser icons or use keyboard shortcuts.

actions.description: Use PyAutoGUI to open browser and navigate

wait_page_load.description: Wait for xiaohongshu.com to load completely

actions.description: Wait for page to fully load

args.intent: Take a screenshot to see if xiaohongshu.com has loaded. Look for the characteristic layout and elements.

find_search_input.description: Find and click the search input using YOLO+LLM+PyAutoGUI

args.intent: Find the search input box on xiaohongshu.com. It should be at the top of the page with placeholder text like '搜索' or '登录探索更多内容'. Use YOLO detection and then click it with PyAutoGUI.

actions.description: YOLO detects search input, LLM identifies it, PyAutoGUI clicks
Use PyAutoGUI to type the search term

wait_search_results.description: Wait for search results and detect posts

args.intent: Take a screenshot of the search results page for 'lulu girl'. Detect all post/content items using YOLO. Look for post cards, images, and clickable content.

actions.description: Detect search result posts with YOLO

click_third_post.description: Find and click the third post using PyAutoGUI

args.intent: From the YOLO-detected posts, identify the THIRD post in the search results (counting from top-left, then left to right). Click on it using PyAutoGUI.

extract_creator.description: Extract creator information from the post page

args.intent: Take a screenshot of the post detail page and extract the creator/author information. Find the creator name, profile link, and any other visible details.

actions.description: Extract creator data using vision analysis
Save creator info to text file
Take final screenshot of the result

test_objectives: Test real page navigation to xiaohongshu.com
Validate YOLO detection on real page
